Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And let my faith reach the most perfect faith
And make my certainty the best certainty
And lead my intentions to the best of intentions
And my actions to the best of actions
O Allah, perfect my intention through Your kindness
And strengthen my certainty with what is with You
And correct through Your power what has been corrupted in me

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And spare me from concerns that preoccupy me
And employ me in that which You will ask me about tomorrow
And make my days occupied with that for which You created me
And enrich me and expand for me Your provision
And do not test me with looking (at what others have)
And honor me and do not afflict me with pride

Arabic text: وَعَبِّدْنِيْ لَكَ وَلَا تُفْسِدْ عِبَادَتِيْ بِالْعُجْبِ
Translation: And make me worship You and do not corrupt my worship with self-conceit
And let good flow to people through my hands
And do not efface it by my reminders of generosity
And grant me the highest moral traits
And protect me from boasting

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَلَا تَرْفَعْنِيْ فِيْ النَّاسِ دَرَجَةً إِلَّا حَطَطْتَنِيْ عِنْدَ نَفْسِيْ مِثْلَهَا
Translation: And do not raise me a degree among people except that You lower me to the same extent in my own eyes

Arabic text: وَلَا تُحْدِثْ لِيْ عِزًّا ظَاهِرًا إِلَّا أَحْدَثْتَ لِيْ ذِلَّةً بَاطِنَةً عِندَ نَفْسِيْ بِقَدَرِهَا
Translation: And do not create for me outward honor without creating for me an equal inner humility in myself

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَمَتِّعْنِيْ بِهُدًى صَالِحٍ لَا أَسْتَبْدِلُ بِهِ
Translation: And provide me with righteous guidance that I will not exchange
And a true path from which I will not deviate
And a pure intention in which I will not doubt

Arabic text: وَعَمِّرْنِيْ مَا كَانَ عُمْرِيْ بِذْلَةً فِيْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And grant me a life that is spent in Your obedience

Arabic text: فَإِذَا كَانَ عُمْرِيْ مَرْتَعًا لِلشَّيْطَانِ فَاقْبِضْنِيْ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And when my life becomes a pasture for Satan, then take me to You
Before Your hatred overtakes me
Or Your wrath against me becomes firm

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ خَصْلَةً تُعَابُ مِنِّيْ إِلَّا أَصْلَحْتَهَا
Translation: O Allah, do not leave any blameworthy characteristic in me except that You correct it

Arabic text: وَلَا عَائِبَةً أُؤَنَّبُ بِهَا إِلَّا حَسَّنْتَهَا
Translation: Nor any fault for which I am criticized except that You improve it

Arabic text: وَلَا أُكْرُوْمَةً فِيَّ نَاقِصَةً إِلَّا أَتْمَمْتَهَا
Translation: Nor any deficient noble trait in me except that You complete it

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَأَبْدِلْنِيْ مِنْ بُغْضَةِ أَهْلِ الشَّنَانِ الْمَحَبَّةَ
Translation: And replace the animosity of the hateful with love
And the envy of the transgressors with affection
And the suspicion of the righteous with trust
And the hostility of close ones with alliance
And the disrespect of relatives with devotion
And the desertion of close ones with help
And the flattery of associates with sincere affection
And the rejection of neighbors with generous companionship

Arabic text: وَمِنْ مَرَارَةِ خَوْفِ الظَّالِمِيْنَ حَلاَوَةَ الْأَمَنَةَ
Translation: And the bitterness of fear of oppressors with the sweetness of security

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ يَدًا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنِي
Translation: And grant me power over those who oppress me
And a tongue over those who dispute with me
And victory over those who stubbornly oppose me

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لِيْ مَكْرًا عَلَى مَنْ كَايَدَنِي
Translation: And grant me cunning against those who scheme against me
And power over those who persecute me
And refutation of those who accuse me falsely
And safety from those who threaten me
And grant me success in obeying those who guide me
And in following those who direct me

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَسَدِّدْنِيْ لِأَنْ أُعَارِضَ مَنْ غَشَّنِيْ بِالنُّصْحِ
Translation: And direct me to counter one who deceives me with good advice
And to repay one who forsakes me with kindness
And to reward one who deprives me with generosity
And to recompense one who cuts me off with connection

Arabic text: وَأُخَالِفَ مَنِ اغْتَابَنِيْ إِلَى حُسْنِ الذِّكْرِ
Translation: And to oppose one who backbites me with good mention
And to be thankful for good deeds
And to ignore evil deeds

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And adorn me with the ornament of the righteous
And clothe me with the adornment of the pious
In spreading justice
And restraining anger
And extinguishing the flames of hatred
And bringing together those who are separated
And reconciling those who are in conflict
And spreading goodness
And concealing faults
And gentleness of disposition
And lowering the wing (of humility)
And excellence of conduct
And calmness of temperament
And pleasantness in behavior
And being foremost in virtue
And preferring graciousness
And abandoning condemnation
And bestowing favors on the undeserving
And speaking the truth, even when it is difficult

Arabic text: وَاسْتِقْلاَلِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِنْ كَثُرَ مِنْ قَوْلِيْ وَفِعْلِي
Translation: And regarding as little the good in my words and deeds, even if abundant

Arabic text: وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الشَّرِ وَإِنْ قَلَّ مِنْ قَوْلِيْ وَفِعْلِي
Translation: And regarding as much the evil in my words and deeds, even if little
And perfect that for me
Through continuing obedience
And adhering to the community
And rejecting the people of innovation
And those who use opinion as innovation

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ إِذَا كَبِرْتُ
Translation: And make Your provision most abundant for me when I grow old
And Your strength most intense in me when I am exhausted
And do not afflict me with laziness in worshipping You
Nor blindness from Your path
Nor undertaking what is contrary to Your love
Nor association with those who separate from You
Nor separation from those who unite with You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ أَصُوْلُ بِكَ عِنْدَ الضَّرُوْرَةِ
Translation: O Allah, make me attack with You when in necessity
And ask You in need
And plead to You in destitution

Arabic text: وَلَا تَفْتِنِّيْ بِالْإِسْتِعَانَةِ بِغَيْرِكَ إِذَا اضْطُرِرْتُ
Translation: And do not tempt me to seek help from other than You when I am desperate

Arabic text: وَلَا بِالْخُضُوْعِ لِسُؤَالِ غَيْرِكَ إِذَا افْتَقَرْتُ
Translation: Nor to humble myself by asking others when I am poor

Arabic text: وَلَا بِالتَّضَرُّعِ إِلَى مَنْ دُوْنَكَ إِذَارَهِبْتُ
Translation: Nor to plead with those less than You when I am afraid
Lest I deserve Your abandonment, Your refusal, and Your turning away
O Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَا يُلْقِيْ الشَّيْطَانُ فِيْ رَوْعِي
Translation: O Allah, make what Satan puts in my mind
Of wishful thinking, suspicion, and envy
A remembrance of Your greatness
And reflection on Your power
And planning against Your enemy

Arabic text: وَمَا أَجْرَى عَلَى لِسَانِيْ مِنْ لَفْظَةِ فُحْشٍ
Translation: And what flows on my tongue of indecent words
Or offensive expressions, or cursing someone's honor
Or false testimony

Arabic text: أَوِ اغْتِيَابِ مُؤْمِنٍ غَائِبٍ أَوْ سَبِّ حَاضِرٍ
Translation: Or backbiting a believer in absence, or insulting one present
Or anything similar to that
Let it become an utterance of praise for You
And immersion in glorifying You
And proceeding in magnifying You
And thanksgiving for Your favor
And acknowledgment of Your goodness
And enumeration of Your blessings

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَلَا أُظْلَمَنَّ وَأَنْتَ مُطِيْقٌ لِلدَّفْعِ عَنِّي
Translation: Let me not be oppressed while You have the power to defend me

Arabic text: وَلَا أَظْلِمَنَّ وَأَنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى الْقَبْضِ مِنِّي
Translation: And let me not oppress while You have the power to restrain me
And let me not go astray while You can guide me
And let me not become poor while my sufficiency is with You
And let me not become rebellious while my wealth comes from You
O Allah, I have come to Your forgiveness
And I have aimed for Your pardon
And I have yearned for Your forbearance
And I have trusted in Your favor

Arabic text: وَلَيْسَ عِنْدِيْ مَا يُوْجِبُ لِيْ مَغْفِرَتَكَ
Translation: And there is nothing with me that earns me Your forgiveness

Arabic text: وَلَا فِيْ عَمَلِيْ مَا أَسْتَحِقُّ بِهِ عَفْوَكَ
Translation: Nor in my deeds that which deserves Your pardon

Arabic text: وَمَا لِيْ بَعْدَ أَنْ حَكَمْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِيْ إِلَّا فَضْلُكَ
Translation: And I have nothing after judging myself except Your grace
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And be gracious to me
O Allah, make me speak with guidance
And inspire me with piety
And guide me to what is purest
And employ me in what is most pleasing to You
O Allah, lead me on the most exemplary path
And make me live and die on Your religion

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant me enjoyment through moderation
And make me among the people of rightness
And from the guides to right conduct
And from the righteous servants
And grant me the triumph of the return (to You)
And the safety of the watching place (on Judgment Day)

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ خُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ مِنْ نَفْسِيْ مَا يُخَلِّصُهَا
Translation: O Allah, take for Yourself from my soul what will purify it

Arabic text: وَأَبْقِيْ لِنَفْسِيْ مِنْ نَفْسِيْ مَا يُصْلِحُهَا
Translation: And retain for my soul from my soul what will reform it
For my soul is perishing unless You protect it
O Allah, You are my preparation if I grieve
And You are my resource if I am deprived
And in You is my seeking help if I am distressed
And with You is compensation for what has passed
And reformation for what is corrupt
And transformation for what You disapprove
So favor me before affliction with well-being
And before asking with giving
And before going astray with guidance
And spare me the burden of people's shame
And grant me security on the Day of Return
And bestow upon me excellence of guidance

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And repel from me through Your kindness
And nourish me with Your blessing
And reform me through Your generosity
And heal me through Your doing
And shade me in Your shelter
And wrap me in Your good pleasure

Arabic text: وَوَفِّقْنِيْ إِذَا اشْتَكَلَتْ عَلَيَّ الْأُمُوْرُ لِأَهْدَاهَا
Translation: And grant me success, when matters become confusing to me, to choose the most guided
And when actions resemble each other, to the purest
And when religious paths contradict each other, to the most pleasing to You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And crown me with sufficiency
And place me in the best position of guardianship
And grant me the truth of guidance
And do not try me with abundance
And grant me the beauty of tranquility
And do not make my life a constant hardship
And do not reject my supplication with rejection
For I do not recognize any rival to You
And I do not call upon any equal with You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And prevent me from extravagance
And protect my provision from waste
And increase my possessions through blessing in them

Arabic text: وَأَصِبْ بِيْ سَبِيْلَ الْهِدَايَةِ لِلْبِرِّ فِيءمَا أُنفِقُ مِنْهُ
Translation: And guide me to the path of guidance in what I spend from it

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And spare me the trouble of earning
And provide for me without reckoning
So that I am not distracted from Your worship by seeking
And do not bear the burden of the consequences of earning
O Allah, grant me what I seek through Your power
And protect me by Your might from what I fear

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And preserve my dignity through prosperity
And do not disgrace my status through poverty
So that I seek provision from those provided by You
And ask for grants from the worst of Your creation
Then I would be tempted to praise those who give me
And be tested with blaming those who deny me

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ مِنْ دُوْنِهِمْ وَلِيُّ الْإِعْطَاءِ وَالْمَنْعِ
Translation: While You alone, not they, are the Master of giving and denying

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant me health in worship
And leisure in piety
And knowledge in practice
And moderation in wisdom
O Allah, seal my term with Your pardon
And confirm my hope in expecting Your mercy
And facilitate my paths to reach Your pleasure
And make my actions beautiful in all my states

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And awaken me to Your remembrance in times of negligence
And employ me in Your obedience during the days of respite

Arabic text: وَانْهَجْ لِيْ إِلَى مَحَبَّتِكَ سَبِيْلًا سَهْلَةً
Translation: And open for me an easy path to Your love

Arabic text: أَكْمِلْ لِيْ بِهَا خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْأٰخِرَةِ
Translation: Complete for me through it the good of this world and the hereafter

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: كَأَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ قَبْلَهُ
Translation: Like the best of what You have blessed anyone of Your creation before him
And what You will bless anyone after him

Arabic text: وَ آتِنَا فِيْ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِيْ الْأٰخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
Translation: And give us good in this world and good in the hereafter
And protect me by Your mercy from the punishment of the Fire
